content:
jon (Support): Customer ACME just escalated — they get an error 'audit_log_missing' when pulling audit exports. They say this started after our incident window 2026-06-05 14:12Z-14:40Z. Case #4567, org org_893. Ping @maria.

maria (Security): on it. Do we have the exact request id / sample API call from customer?

jon (Support): attached a screenshot in the case, but here's the request id: req_0a9f3. They called /v1/orgs/org_893/audit/export?start=... and got 404. Also asked if their KMS key was affected.

ashley (SRE): saw increased 5xx on audit-log-writer during that window. Metric spike: audit-writes.error_rate 14:15->14:28. I can pull logs.

maria (Security): quick triage I ran: audit index shows events until 14:12 then gap until 14:29. Need to confirm whether it's a retention purge or write failure. Also check KMS logs for decrypt/encrypt errors.

devex-bot: automated KMS check: key kms-prod-org_893 last used 2026-06-05T14:10Z; no failed decrypts reported. Last rotation 2025-11-02.

ashley (SRE): repro steps I used against staging:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_893/audit/export?start=2026-06-05T14:00Z&end=2026-06-05T15:00Z"
# got 404 with body {"error":"audit_log_missing"}
```
Logs show backend returned 200 to write-ingester but the write failed to persist due to a transient NFS timeout. See log snippet:
```
WARN 14:16:12 writer Unable to persist batch: timeout waiting for mountpoint /mnt/audit (errno=110)
```

maria (Security): that suggests writes dropped rather than retention purge. Need to confirm backups contain the missing window. ashley, can you check if s3/audit-backups has objects for that shard and timeframe?

ashley (SRE): checking... s3://redwood-audit-backups/org_893/2026-06-05/14-?? -- quick lookup: we have partial uploads: 14:00-14:12 present, 14:12-14:29 missing. Starting restore job now to see if uploader retried.

lucas (Customer Success): customer wants explicit confirmation if any logs containing PII were lost and whether we'll notify all affected customers. They want timeline and remediation steps.

maria (Security): proposed scope: initial impact appears limited to org_893 (writes failed for that shard). No signs of KMS compromise. Proposal: 1) Confirm backup recovery for missing window (ashley), 2) Confirm KMS/HSM logs (maria), 3) Draft customer notification limited to affected orgs with timeline + remediation, 24h SLA for customer-facing note. If backups irrecoverable, escalate to legal.

jon (Support): customer specifically asked if their audit retention settings (90d) were overridden. Any config drift checks?

ashley (SRE): config diffs show no retention policy changes for org_893. The likely root cause is the NFS mount instability during that window leading to dropped writes, not a retention rule change.

maria (Security): HSM/KMS logs checked: no failed decrypts, no unauthorized key policy changes. HSM audit shows normal heartbeat. So KMS not in scope for key compromise, but we still document key usage in the notification.

devex-bot: incident tracker updated: INC-2026-063 created, severity P2, affected orgs: org_893. Owner: maria.

maria (Security): action items: ashley to produce a recovery verdict (backup recovered / unrecoverable) by EOD (1765127056). If unrecoverable, we notify customer and legal within 4 hours of verdict. Jon to draft the customer note now — I'll review.

jon (Support): sketching the note: short, empathetic, what happened, scope limited to audit exports between 14:12-14:29 UTC on 2026-06-05 for org_893, what we did (investigated, recovery attempt, next steps), contact info.

lucas (Customer Success): ack. Keep me in the loop; I'll prepare a VIP handling plan in case they escalate.

maria (Security): I'll close the triage here once ashley confirms backup. tagging @everyone in thread for visibility :warning:

ashley (SRE): backup recovery job finished: partial success — we have 14:15-14:29 reconstructed from redundant uplinks; single event loss of ~0.2% estimated. attaching export link in case.

jon (Support): passed to customer: they asked for exact events lost count. ashley can you provide estimate? also they want confirmation no keys exposed.

ashley (SRE): estimate: ~120 events missing (non-PII metadata mostly). KMS logs show no exposure. I'll attach CSV and checksum.

maria (Security): good. customer note ready — short summary + timeline + confirm KMS not impacted + offer export of recovered events and CSV of lost events. Approve sending in next 2 hours. Closing thread after customer ack.

jon (Support): sending now. Thanks all :tada:
